svg.title: Owner hot spot of point-to-point replication
svg.desc: (a) Point-to-point copies: the owner of a hot expert sends one copy per replica; (b) in-switch multicast: one send-out per hot expert; (c) simulated trace replay of a greedy planner: weights sent by the busiest rank at EP8, EP16 and EP24, point to point versus multicast.
